fact_text: The analyst said market sentiment was firm as FY26 started, citing growth in oil marketing company numbers and improving government finances.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst said monthly figures for oil marketing companies showed growth above prior years, which he read as a possible sign of rising industrial activity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: Motor spirit (petrol) volumes were rising, partly from generator use, and the analyst said high-speed diesel, which is closely correlated with industrial growth, is the signal to track.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: Pakistan State Oil held about 63 percent of Pakistan's total petroleum market in the analyst's past models.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: PSO's share of volume handling had fallen to about 40 percent by 2 Jul 2025, as the government reduced furnace oil supply through the company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst said PSO's products other than furnace oil carry higher margins, while furnace oil had little or no margin.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The government raised the OMC margin over the past two years from about Rs 3 to Rs 7 per litre, which the analyst said improves OMC profitability.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: Foreign investment in Pakistan's OMCs had been limited to small stakes, while a Saudi-linked buyer, Wafi, took over Shell's Pakistan business, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst expected PSO's FY26 earnings to rise above its FY25 level, helped by better OMC margins and expected progress on circular-debt receivables.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: On 1 Jul 2025 about 20 to 21 percent of SSGC's free float, roughly 308 to 309 million shares, traded, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: SSGC's fixed-return formula means capex additions can lift its operating profit, and gas price increases also feed through to its earnings, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst said three quarters of SSGC's FY25 results were still to come after the first-quarter result.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's market capitalisation reached about 2 billion dollars after its share price rose.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's share price opened near Rs 350 after a share split from a level of about Rs 1,700, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst said Lucky Cement traded at about 7 to 8 times earnings, a multiple he considered could still rise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst said cement exporters, including Lucky Cement and Attock Cement, were supported by export dispatches, while local dispatches had not grown.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst uses price-to-book value as a benchmark for banks, noting many banks trade well below their book value.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab has traded far below its book value for many years, which the analyst cited as a valuation gap.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: National Bank of Pakistan traded far below its book value of about Rs 180 to 200 per share before its price re-rated, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)

fact_text: The analyst said that if state-owned enterprises cut their receivables by about Rs 450-500 billion over nine months, their balance sheets and borrowing would improve.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📈 Midday Flash | 2 July 2025 | PSX Rallies 1500+ Points | FY26 Brings Optimism | OMCs & Banks' (YouTube, 2025-07-02)
